sections.heading: Info
sections.text: The Ballistic plate case is a container with the purpose of saving space within the player's inventory. It provides 96 inventory slots in a 8x12 grid and only takes up 8 inventory slots itself. Only armor plates can be stored in it.

sections.heading: Quest rewards
sections.text:
- 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from Sisyphus
- 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from Setting Priorities
- 1 can be obtained as a quest reward from Hypotheses Testing

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: - Easter eggs and References: The Ballistic plate case is modeled after the BX135 Cargo Case by Pelican.
